deploy.verify: curl -f http://localhost:8088/api/health (GET /api/health; also the Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK); docker exec -it octop octop --version confirms the effective version; open http://localhost:8088 and sign in with the first-boot credentials
deploy.rollback: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml down (keeps the mounted ~/.octop data volume) and redeploy a known-good image with docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build; inspect with docker logs -f octop

it.success_criteria: make test (uv run pytest -n auto -m "not live") exits 0 with every unit and tests/integration case passing; the CI quality gate (make install, make lint, make typecheck, make test) stays green on Linux and Windows; live-marked tests stay excluded when real credentials are absent; an empty or all-skipped run is not a pass
